notes: v2.2: the update download now SHOWS what is happening in both apps (PC gate + updater dialog, phone updater): live percent done, MB downloaded / total MB, current download speed and a status line naming the phase (connecting / downloading / installing / failed with a plain reason), repainting about twice a second. New controls on the download: Pause (keeps the partial file and its byte count; the control becomes Resume), Resume (continues from that byte offset via HTTP Range; if the server refuses Range the download restarts from zero and the status line says so plainly) and a cross Cancel (deletes the partial and returns to the gate's choices). Pause and Cancel never consume a skip; the skip rule is unchanged (max 2 per version). Gate rules otherwise unchanged. Update channel unchanged (GitHub).
